Mike (misnamed Harry Cane in 5784 Soccer Mania) is an Adventurers Dino Island minifigure introduced in 2000. He appears in several Adventurers sets, as well as having an appearance in the video game LEGO Racers 2.

page.overview:
Who is Mike?

Mike (misnamed Harry Cane in 5784 Soccer Mania) is an Adventurers Dino Island minifigure introduced in 2000. He appears in several Adventurers sets, as well as having an appearance in the video game LEGO Racers 2.

Mike wears an earth orange vest over a white shirt, grey pants, and an earth orange Western Cap. His torso is also printed with two buttons on his shirt collar, a grey rope belt, and a slingshot tucked into his belt. His face is printed with black hair, eyebrows, freckles, and dimples that give him a youthful appearance.

As a Studios actor, Mike wears a bright red Safari Hat, and the back of his torso is printed with the LEGO logo.

In 5784 Soccer Mania, Harry Cane retains Mike's head but otherwise has a completely different outfit. He has a brick yellow jacket worn over a light green and dark green striped shirt, black pants, and an earth orange Safari Hat. Since "Harry Cane" has Mike's face while the real Harry Cane appears in the same game as "Billy Speed", this character is most likely intended to represent Mike.
